name: sage-x3-desk
description: Sage X3 Desk - Hybrid Hosting Architecture (Frontend, Backend, DB, AI)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: node kill-ports.cjs && node ai/start-ai.cjs && npm --prefix backend start
scripts.start:full: node kill-ports.cjs && node ai/start-ai.cjs && concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
